title: Standard flat single base change on the canonical pullback square
statement: Let Y, B and A be schemes [def-pc-scheme], p : Y → B quasi-compact and quasi-separated, M a quasi-coherent module on Y [pqf-def-coherent] flat over p [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], and g : A → B. Let q : Y ×_B A → Y and r : Y ×_B A → A be the canonical pullback projections [def-pc-fibre-product]. In the standard derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category], there exists an isomorphism Rr_*((q^*M)[0]) ≅ Lg^*(Rp_*(M[0])), where q^* is ordinary tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], Rr_* and Rp_* are derived direct images [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and Lg^* is derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback].

source.place: Tag 0A1D, lemma-base-change-tensor, specialized to E = O_Y[0] and G = M[0]

proof.text: Construct the canonical forward mate followed by direct image of the single-module pullback counit, without selecting any isomorphism witness.
For each integer n obtain monicity and epicity of the degree-n cohomology map from the two separate cohomological lemmas. In the abelian category of module sheaves, mono plus epi implies isomorphism.
Apply DerivedCategory.isIso_iff to the canonical comparison: its cohomology maps are invertible in all degrees. Form asIso, invert its orientation, and package it in Nonempty.

lean.statement:
theorem standard_flat_single_baseChange
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (hM : M.IsFlatOver p) (g : A ⟶ B) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    Nonempty ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd p g)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback p g).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (pullback.fst p g) M)) ≅
      (derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage p).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj M)))
